These findings challenge the assumption that disagreement is inherently divisive and extend interpersonal relationship research by providing a better understanding of its consequences. They point to listening quality as a pathway to SWB and social connection, even when views are opposing.
articles.keywords: Active listening; Psychology; Social psychology; Interpersonal communication; Competence; Autonomy; Multilevel model; Interpersonal relationship; Optimism; Social competence
articles.summary: 本研究通过五项实验发现，高质量倾听能通过满足基本心理需求，特别是关系需求，显著提升说话者的状态幸福感和乐观主义，即使在意见分歧的情况下。分歧时的高质量倾听甚至能带来比同意时中等质量倾听更高的幸福感，这挑战了分歧天生破坏人际关系的传统观点。

articles.title: The impact of "relational" Artificial Intelligence on human well-being: A self-determination theory analysis.
articles.authors: Michael A. Irias, Norman B. Schmidt, Thomas E. Joiner, James K. McNulty
articles.journal: Journal of Personality and Social Psychology
articles.publish_info: Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, 2026-06-22
articles.abstract: Advances in generative artificial intelligence (AI) have given rise to relational AI-AI agents that mimic human relational capabilities while possessing unique nonhuman features, including constant availability, extensive malleability, and a lack of intrinsic psychological needs. This article uses self-determination theory to examine how relational AI may support or undermine the three basic psychological needs self-determination theory posits as essential for well-being: relatedness, competence, and autonomy. Across roles including that of tutor, copilot, social mediator, companion, and therapist, relational AI may address critical challenges to these needs, facilitating goal attainment, alleviating loneliness, and promoting mental health. However, relational AI also carries potential risks for well-being, including reduced self-direction, diminished efficacy, and altered expectations within human relationships. We propose that relational AI's ultimate impact on users' well-being will depend on moderating factors that may shape both the strength and direction of its effects on well-being, including users' motivational orientation toward the goal for which they use relational AI, their motivational orientation for using relational AI, their baseline psychological need satisfaction, dynamics particular to each relational AI role, and various situational factors. Crucially, it is likely impossible to fully understand relational AI's impacts on well-being without examining all three psychological needs, as focusing on only a single need risks overlooking dynamics in which impacts on multiple needs interact to amplify or neutralize well-being. Future research on these processes can deepen our understanding of human relationship dynamics, inform responsible AI development, and reveal novel theoretical mechanisms underlying relational AI's impacts on well-being.
articles.keywords: Psychology; Human intelligence; Social psychology; Artificial intelligence; Cognitive science; Cognitive psychology; Artificial psychology; Cognition; Psychological Theory
articles.summary: 本研究运用自我决定理论分析了关系型人工智能对人类幸福的影响。文章指出，关系型AI可能通过满足或损害关联性、能力与自主性等基本心理需求来影响用户幸福，其效果取决于多种调节因素。未来研究需综合考察多个心理需求的交互作用，以全面理解AI对幸福的复杂影响。

articles.title: Security priming in everyday life: How do symbols of close others support attachment in adulthood?
articles.authors: Karl E. Conroy, R. Chris Fraley
articles.journal: Journal of Personality and Social Psychology
articles.publish_info: Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, Vol. 130, Issue 6, 2026-06
articles.abstract: Security priming refers to the idea that exposure to simple, attachment-relevant cues-such as photographs of loved ones-can enhance psychological security and related outcomes. While security priming effects have been robustly demonstrated in laboratory settings, there is growing interest in whether such techniques can be effectively applied in everyday contexts, with an eye toward scalable interventions. In the present research, we examined whether using a romantic partner's photo as a phone lock screen image could influence attachment security. In Study 1 (N = 4,741), we found that people who had images of their romantic partners on their lock screens reported greater attachment security. In Study 2 (N = 306), participants in romantic relationships were randomly assigned to add photos of their partners to their lock screens. We found that, although there was evidence of selection effects (i.e., secure people having those images on their screens already), there were no security priming effects. In Study 3 (N = 249), participants were randomly assigned to remove images of their partners from their screens. In contrast to Study 2, this removal led to measurable declines in attachment security over time. These findings suggest that while lock screen images may reflect existing levels of security, their removal-rather than their addition-can have detectable psychological effects. We discuss the implications for designing low-cost, scalable interventions aimed at enhancing attachment security and for understanding the role of "invisible infrastructure" in shaping psychological functioning.
articles.keywords: Psychology; Priming; Lock; Romance; Social psychology; Phone; Attachment theory; Selection
articles.summary: 本研究考察了使用浪漫伴侣照片作为手机锁屏图像对依恋安全的影响。通过三个研究发现，现有伴侣照片与更高的依恋安全相关，但添加照片并无启动效应；相反，移除照片会导致依恋安全下降，表明移除已有情感线索比添加新线索更具心理影响。

articles.title: Is my loneliness killing me? Effects of loneliness and social isolation on transitions between cognitive status categories and death.
articles.authors: Tomiko Yoneda, Kathryn L. Jackson, Emily C. Noyer, Christopher R. Beam, Gabrielle Pfund, Stephen Antonoplis, Emorie Beck, Katy Bedjeti, Pei Qin, Kayla M. Garner, Jing Luo, Karina Van Bogart, Lily Pieramici, Katherina Hauner, Nicholas A. Turiano, Páraic S. O'Súilleabháin, Lisa Barnes, David A. Bennett, Graciela Muniz Terrera, Daniel K. Mroczek, Bryan D. James, Andrew Steptoe, Anthony D. Ong, Eileen K. Graham
articles.journal: Journal of Personality and Social Psychology
articles.publish_info: Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, 2026-06-15
articles.abstract: Loneliness and social isolation are associated with numerous adverse physical and psychological health outcomes in older adulthood, including cognitive impairment and mortality risk. Yet, how the individual and joint effects of loneliness and social isolation contribute to these outcomes remains unclear, particularly given the interplay between individual differences (loneliness) and environmental factors (social isolation) in shaping these important health outcomes in older adulthood (i.e., person-environment interactions). We used Cox regression, logistic regression, and multistate survival models to systematically investigate the individual and adjusted associations among loneliness, social isolation, cognitive aging outcomes, and mortality risk. Further, extensive between-study variability in operational definitions, modeling approaches, and covariate adjustments may be contributing to mixed results in the existing literature. In this registered report, we applied a multistudy approach (i.e., coordinated data analysis) in which independent but identical models were fit across 11 longitudinal studies representing participants from 18 countries (Ntotal = 175,070). Random effects meta-analyses synthesized results across studies, showing that loneliness was consistently associated with an elevated risk of cognitive impairment and mortality across statistical approaches, even after adjusting for social isolation. Conversely, social isolation was not consistently associated with cognitive impairment and showed weaker associations with mortality risk. Together, our findings suggest that loneliness is a robust, proximal predictor of major aging outcomes and highlight avenues for theory development, strategies to strengthen cognitive resilience and independence in older adulthood, and more efficient resource allocation of public health resources.
articles.keywords: Loneliness; Psychology; Social isolation; Cognition; Isolation; Psychological resilience; Developmental psychology; Independence; Social cognition; Public health
articles.summary: 本研究通过协调分析11项跨国纵向研究数据（涉及18个国家），使用多种统计模型发现，孤独感与老年人认知障碍和死亡风险升高存在稳健关联，即使调整社交隔离后；而社交隔离与这些健康结果的关联较弱或不一致。这表明孤独感是衰老相关结局的近端预测因子，对理论发展和公共健康资源分配有重要启示。

articles.title: Applicants of color encounter discrimination based on cultural foreignness stereotypes in the labor market.
articles.authors: Terrènce Pope, Linda Zou, Fasika Hailu, Laura Banham, Mona El-Hout, Sapna Cheryan
articles.publish_info: Journal of Experimental Psychology: General, Vol. 155, Issue 6, 2026-06
articles.abstract: The stereotype that people of color are less American than White Americans may lead to hiring and employment discrimination. We test this prediction in four experiments that simulate hiring decisions with White adults, White students, and racially diverse students (total N = 2,146) and one archival analysis (330 discrimination cases). We further identify job contexts where this form of discrimination is likely to occur and which groups may be most vulnerable. In Studies 1 and 2, Asian and Latino Americans were less likely to be selected than Black Americans for a job that emphasized stereotypically American characteristics (e.g., English skills, familiarity with American culture), even when their first names were Anglicized. Stereotypes about Asian and Latino Americans' cultural foreignness mediated their lower perceived hireability. Extending to a broader range of racial identities, gender identities, and job contexts revealed that for a stereotypically American job, Asian, Arab, and Latino/a American men and women were perceived as less hireable than Black Americans, who were perceived as less hireable than White Americans. However, when a job favored stereotypically high-status characteristics (e.g., technical skills, advanced education), Black, Latino/a, and Arab American men and women were perceived as less hireable than Asian and White Americans (Studies 3 and 4). An analysis of U.S. employment discrimination court cases revealed that Asian, Arab, and Latino American plaintiffs were more likely than Black American plaintiffs to report experiencing discrimination based on cultural foreignness stereotypes (Study 5). Findings illuminate when, why, and for whom stereotypes about cultural foreignness shape experiences with racial discrimination in the U.S. labor market.
articles.keywords: White; Racism; Asian americans; Plaintiff; Social psychology; Psychology; Ethnic group; Employment discrimination; Cultural diversity; African american
articles.summary: 本研究通过四项实验和一项档案分析，检验文化外群体刻板印象如何导致劳动力市场中的雇佣歧视。结果发现，亚洲和拉丁裔美国人因被视为文化外来者而在强调美国特征的工作中可雇用性较低，但在强调高地位特征的工作中，其他种族群体面临更严重的歧视。美国就业歧视案例的分析进一步证实了文化刻板印象对歧视体验的影响。

articles.title: How managers can unintentionally disadvantage employees with mental illness: An extrinsic interpersonal emotion regulation perspective.
articles.authors: Tessa Neilson, Daniel L. Brady, Laurie J. Barclay
articles.publish_info: Journal of Experimental Psychology: General, Vol. 155, Issue 6, 2026-06
articles.abstract: Extensive scholarly attention has focused on how employees with mental illness can face barriers in the workplace (e.g., stigmatizing perceptions, such as perceiving those with mental illness as incompetent, dangerous, or lacking resilience). Drawing on interpersonal emotion regulation motivation theory, we explore whether managers may unintentionally disadvantage employees with mental illness via interpersonal emotion regulation. Our general argument is that managers may perceive that employees with mental illness are less able to regulate negative emotions in challenging situations (e.g., receiving negative performance feedback). This can prompt managers to fear for their employees' well-being and engage in interpersonal emotional regulation by reducing the quality of negative performance feedback that they provide. We also examine whether activating a coaching motive (i.e., enhancing managers' awareness related to the importance of providing all employees with high-quality negative feedback) can overcome these effects. To empirically test our model, we develop and validate scales for our proposed mechanisms: perceived negative emotion regulation inability and fear for well-being. Using samples with managerial experience from the United States and Canada (N = 1,303), we test our hypotheses across three studies. Theoretical and practical implications include recognizing why and how employees with mental illness may face subtle disadvantages in the workplace due to interpersonal emotion regulation, understanding what motivates managers to engage in extrinsic interpersonal emotional regulation for employees with mental illness, and showcasing how reducing the subtle disadvantages employees with mental illness experience may be especially difficult.
articles.keywords: Psychology; Mental illness; Interpersonal communication; Social psychology; Disadvantage; Argument; Interpersonal relationship; Test; Emotional contagion; Quality
articles.summary: 本研究基于人际情绪调节动机理论，探讨经理如何可能因感知精神疾病员工的情绪调节能力较弱而无意中减少负面绩效反馈质量，从而造成员工劣势。通过三项研究验证了这一机制，并考察了激活教练动机的干预效果。

articles.title: Artificial intelligence and machines are capable of harm, but not of experiencing punishment.
articles.authors: Alexander Eng, Kai Chi Yam
articles.abstract: Algorithms, robots, and artificial intelligence are increasingly making morally salient decisions (e.g., medical triage) and taking actions (e.g., terminate employees). Extant research suggests that we can and do perceive machines to be responsible for moral harm. Unlike human perpetrators, however, we suggest that we do not experience the same level of justice satisfaction after punishing machine perpetrators. Through a series of experimental paradigms, we first show that people do perceive machines as capable of wrongdoings and punish them accordingly (Pilot Study), but that people experience lower levels of justice satisfaction after punishing machines compared to human perpetrators (Study 1). Studies 2 and 3 replicate some of these findings, whereas Study 4 tests two mechanisms that might account for these effects-punishment as communication and punishment as retribution. A final supplemental study explores whether the dissatisfaction from punishing machines would cause people to displace their aggression onto innocent human bystanders. Our findings demonstrate that machines can commit wrongs and that people attempt to punish them, yet such punishment does not consistently restore a sense of justice relative to punishing humans. This pattern underscores the need for further research on how people understand and respond to machine wrongdoing.
articles.keywords: Psychology; Commit; Punishment; Economic Justice; Aggression; Salient; Social psychology; Extant taxon; Scapegoating; Human factors and ergonomics
articles.summary: 本研究探讨了人们对人工智能道德责任的感知及其惩罚后果，发现人们认为机器能够犯错并会惩罚它们，但惩罚机器后的正义满意度低于惩罚人类。实验还揭示，惩罚机器可能导致攻击转移，引发对无辜人类的敌意。

articles.title: Interventions to reduce implicit weight bias: A focus on mechanisms and individual differences.
articles.authors: Amanda Ravary, Mark W. Baldwin
articles.abstract: Implicit weight bias-an automatic negative evaluation of individuals with higher weight-is pervasive in society. Intervention efforts to reduce implicit weight bias have been sparse and rarely successful. However, a recent set of studies by Lai and Le Forestier (2025) found supportive evidence for successful modification of weight bias by testing a variety of mechanistic, theoretically grounded interventions based on procedures already shown to be effective in reducing implicit racial bias. In the present study, which extends that work, 1,305 adult participants completed a Weight Implicit Association Test before and after one of five online interventions or a control condition. Four of the five interventions tested yielded reductions in bias, compared to the control condition. We also adopted an inductive, data-driven approach to assess individual differences in response: Results demonstrated that interventions may be particularly impactful to the extent that individuals are optimally matched with procedures that suit their personal characteristics. Overall, this work provides additional evidence for the overall efficacy of interventions that are directed toward the known social cognitive mechanisms of implicit bias and reveals avenues for future research into moderators of intervention outcomes.
articles.keywords: Psychology; Psychological intervention; Implicit-association test; Intervention; Set; Implicit attitude; Cognitive psychology; Association; Cognition; Social cognitive theory
articles.summary: 本研究评估了减少隐性体重偏见的在线干预措施，通过比较五种干预与控制条件发现，其中四种能有效降低偏见水平。数据分析揭示干预效果存在个体差异，表明个性化匹配可能增强干预效果。

articles.title: The functional neurobiology of dispositions towards negative emotions.
articles.authors: M Sicorello, P J Gianaros, A G C Wright, B Petre, T E Kraynak, S B Manuck, C Schmahl, T D Wager
articles.abstract: People differ in their tendency to experience negative emotions. This variability is largely captured by broad psychological constructs like neuroticism, whose facets include anxiety, depression, and stress vulnerability, among others. The amygdala and salience network have been assumed to underlie such dispositions, despite inconsistent evidence. We preregistered a comprehensive test of these and other competing hypotheses-accompanied by theory-agnostic machine learning prediction-using neural responses in the two most common emotional neuroimaging tasks (scenes and faces; N = 338/424). Evidence including Bayes factors indicated that neuroticism is not associated with any region, network, affective signature, or machine learning pattern, including the amygdala. Still, a brain-wide machine learning pattern robustly predicted the neuroticism facet stress vulnerability (r = .21), replicated in an independent dataset (r = .19). Predictive performance most strongly depended on somatomotor and visual networks, rather than salience network regions, relating stress vulnerability to cortical perception-action systems. Together with a multiverse analysis spanning 14 trait constructs and 1,176 models, our findings demonstrate the highly selective predictability of emotional dispositions from brain responses to common affective tasks. Therein, they highlight the importance of construct and task selection, while challenging the role of the most commonly used neural markers, including responses of the amygdala and salience network.
articles.keywords: Psychology; Salience; Neuroimaging; Cognitive psychology; Neuroticism; Trait; Amygdala; Construct; Functional neuroimaging; Vulnerability
articles.summary: 本研究探讨了人们对负面情绪倾向的个体差异，发现神经质与杏仁核或显著性网络无关联，但压力脆弱性可通过涉及体感运动和视觉网络的脑部机器学习模式预测，挑战了常用神经标记的普遍作用。

articles.title: In-scanner thoughts contribute to resting-state functional connectivity.
articles.authors: Javier Gonzalez-Castillo, Megan A Spurney, Ka Chun Lam, Isabel S Gephart, Francisco Pereira, Daniel A Handwerker, Julia W Y Kam, Peter A Bandettini
articles.abstract: Resting-state fMRI (rsfMRI) scans-acquired in the absence of experimentally controlled stimuli or task demands-are widely used to identify aberrant patterns of functional connectivity (FC) in clinical populations. To minimize interpretational uncertainty, researchers routinely control for across-cohort disparities in age, gender, comorbidities, and head motion. Yet, studies rarely consider the possibility that systematic differences in inner experience (i.e., how subjects think and feel during the scan) directly affect FC measures. Here, using an rsfMRI dataset comprising 469 scans with retrospective experiential annotations, we show that summary descriptors of in-scanner experience are reproducible across visits and subject-specific, consistent with trait-like characteristics. We further show that widespread significant differences in FC are observed between scans that are associated with different reported experiential profiles, and that FC can predict specific experiential dimensions with performance comparable to that reported for demographic, cognitive, and clinical variables. Together, these findings highlight the key role that in-scanner experience should play when interpreting FC in the context of rsfMRI. Given that the available experiential measures are retrospective summaries, these results speak to stable experiential tendencies rather than potential moment-to-moment, state-dependent relationships between ongoing experience and concurrent brain activity.
articles.keywords: Experiential learning; Context; Functional connectivity; Task; Psychology; Cognitive psychology; Affect; Patient experience
articles.summary: 本研究利用静息态 fMRI 数据，探讨了扫描期间内在体验（包括情感和思想）对功能连接的影响。结果表明，扫描体验特征具有跨访问和受试者的可重复性，不同体验特征的功能连接存在显著差异，且功能连接能预测特定的体验维度。这些发现强调了内在体验在静息态功能连接研究中的关键作用。

articles.title: About time? The role of time perspective in the priority for positive over negative emotion in attention
articles.authors: Briana L. Kennedy, Mara Mather
articles.abstract: Compared to younger adults, older adults often prioritise processing positive information and deprioritize processing negative information. Known as the positivity effect, its mechanisms remain debated. One explanation of the positivity effect is that older adults are influenced by a sense of limited time left in life to focus more on emotional well-being compared with younger adults. Previous research shows that experimentally manipulating time perspective can mimic the positivity effect in younger adults, however, such findings have relied on designs where participants can reflect on emotional images they are viewing. In the current study, we examined if time perspective manipulations would similarly elicit positivity effect patterns in younger adults using an emotion-attention task with a rapid stimuli display. Across three experiments (N = 236, N = 431, and N = 259), we found that time perspective had little influence on attentional biases toward positive over negative emotional stimuli in younger adults. Additionally, when we incorporated a memory task into the design, effects of time perspective were not consistent with previous findings - in fact, patterns were in the opposite direction. We discuss these results as they relate to theories and the advantages and disadvantages of tasks used to examine the positivity effect.
articles.keywords: Positivity effect; aging; attention; emotion
articles.summary: 本研究探讨时间视角是否影响年轻人对正面与负面情绪刺激的注意偏向。通过三项快速呈现的实验发现，时间视角对注意力偏向几乎没有影响，且在包含记忆任务的设计中，效果与先前研究相反。研究讨论了这些发现对积极效应理论和研究任务方法的启示。

articles.title: Remembering affect between moments: assessing peak-end effects in continuous affect measures
articles.authors: Leonie Cloos, Wolf Vanpaemel, Eva Ceulemans, Peter Kuppens
articles.abstract: In experience sampling (ESM) studies, participants are measured repeatedly to track momentary affect changes. The data is collected in specific time intervals, leaving gaps between assessments. To capture affective changes between assessments, we developed a measure where participants retrospectively draw their affect in a continuous drawing. This approach, while more complete, may be influenced by retrospective biases, such as the peak-end effect, where intense or recent moments are remembered disproportionately. In an ESM study, 115 participants rated their momentary positive and negative affect six times daily, drew affect changes between assessments, reported events, and completed one daily measurement burst with up to six momentary ratings. We examined the divergence of the retrospective continuous affect drawings from the momentary affect and event ratings, respectively. For positive affect, intensity and recency were associated with lower divergence; the association was nonlinear. Divergence was greatest at low intensity and reduced at moderate to high levels. For negative affect, intensity was associated with higher divergence and recency with lower divergence. The effect of intensity diminished over time, indicating that divergence is mostly determined by recency. Findings were similar for events, except that for negative events, there was no recency effect. Future research should consider the effect of time and intensity, especially the differential effect of positive and negative intensity, on short retrospective ESM measures.
articles.keywords: Experience sampling; affect dynamics; continuous affect; peak-end rule; retrospective self-report
articles.summary: 本研究在经验取样框架下，开发了一种回顾性连续情感绘制方法，以捕捉评估间隙的情感变化。结果发现，回顾性偏差受情感强度和时效性影响，正负情感表现出不同模式：正情感偏差在低强度时最大并随强度增加而减小，负情感偏差主要由时效性决定，强度效应随时间减弱。

articles.title: Effects of experimentally induced jealousy on support for feminine honor
articles.authors: Pelin Gul, Stephen Foster, Sajad Sojoudi, Tom R. Kupfer
articles.abstract: Feminine honor norms require women to uphold a reputation for sexual purity through behaviors such as dressing modestly or maintaining virginity before marriage. While the consequences of these norms for women's health and well-being are well-documented, their socio-psychological origins remain poorly understood. The dominant account holds that feminine honor is endorsed because female infidelity threatens a male partner's honor. An alternative explanation - the ideological mate-guarding account - proposes that support for feminine honor is rooted in psychological motives related to mate guarding and is shaped by sexual jealousy and mating strategy. However, previous evidence for this account has been correlational and based on trait-level measures of jealousy. Here, we provide initial experimental evidence for this account by inducing state sexual jealousy, which was associated with increased support for feminine honor, particularly among men. Additionally, individuals with a more restricted mating orientation (lower socio-sexuality) showed greater support for feminine honor across genders, even after controlling for state masculinity threat, other honor norms (masculine, family, integrity), religiosity, political conservatism, and age. These findings highlight the importance of mating motives in shaping support for feminine honor and enrich our understanding of how evolved psychological mechanisms contribute to the maintenance of traditional gender norms.
articles.keywords: Feminine honor; mate guarding; mating strategy; sexual jealousy; sociosexual orientation
articles.summary: 本研究通过实验诱导状态性性嫉妒，发现性嫉妒能增强对女性贞操荣誉规范的支持，尤其在男性中更为显著。同时，交配取向较限制的个体无论性别都更支持此类规范。研究结果强调了交配心理动机在维持传统性别规范中的重要作用。

articles.title: Others' facial and bodily expressions of emotion modulate willingness to engage in joint action - but actions and objects matter too
articles.authors: Melanie Y. Lam, Lauren Clark, Hope Chambers, Britta Krüger, Johannes Keck
articles.abstract: Emotions are fundamental to social cognition, yet their role in joint action remains underexplored. This study examined how emotional expressions (angry, sad, happy, and neutral) influence behavioural readiness (willingness to engage) in an object-handover task. Across two experiments, participants rated their willingness to "give" or "take" an object (spoon or knife) while viewing dynamic point-light displays (PLDs) of facial (Experiment 1) or bodily (Experiment 2) expressions. Results showed that, although both modalities influenced willingness, guided social decision-making relied on distinct functional heuristics. For facial expressions, a strong emotion-action congruency effect emerged: positive expressions facilitated prosocial "giving", whereas anger, a direct threat cue, inhibited willingness to engage, particularly when paired with a dangerous object. In contrast, bodily expressions were interpreted through a lens of physical vulnerability and predictability. For example, sad and neutral bodies elicited high willingness, suggesting they were perceived as low-threat or stable. Notably, across both experiments, self-directed "take" actions overrode emotional cues, indicating that personal goals may diminish sensitivity to others' expressions. These findings suggest that facial and bodily cues are not functionally equivalent. Rather, they provide complementary social information (intent vs. readiness) that uniquely shapes coordination in joint action contexts.
articles.keywords: Emotional expressions; joint action; object-handover task; point-light displays; willingness to engage
articles.category: Emotion, Facial Expression, Emotion Expression, Face, Social Cognition
articles.summary: 本研究通过物体传递任务考察了面部和身体情绪表达对参与联合行动意愿的影响。结果显示，面部表达通过情绪-行动一致性效应调节意愿，而身体表达则基于脆弱性和可预测性解释起作用；自我导向的行动覆盖情绪线索，表明面部和身体线索功能不同并提供互补社会信息。

articles.title: Verbal humour preventively regulates negative emotions in trait anxiety individuals: ERP evidence
articles.authors: Xueyan Li, Bing Yan, Bo Zhao, Han Wang, Yetian Wang, Huili Wang
articles.abstract: This study investigated whether verbal humour could preventively regulate negative emotions in high trait anxiety (HTA) and low trait anxiety (LTA) individuals, exploring underlying cognitive neural mechanisms using ERPs and ERO. In a two-factor mixed design, humorous stimuli elicited more positive emotions than neutral condition, with greater emotional improvement in the LTA group. Humour also modulated subsequent negative-stimulus processing: LTA individuals showed reduced P2 amplitude in the humorous condition, indicating decreased early attention to negative stimuli, whereas both groups showed enhanced LPC, suggesting altered late evaluative processing. During humour processing, humorous stimuli elicited larger LAN and sustained LAN amplitudes, reflecting increased cognitive resource allocation during incongruity detection and resolution. LTA individuals further showed stronger late humour-related processing than HTA individuals, as indexed by larger LPP amplitude and greater theta activity. Supplementary analyses showed that Theta negatively predicted LPP, Beta negatively predicted downstream P2, and the Beta-LAN association was present only in the HTA group. However, delta-based regression and mediation analyses provided limited support for specific upstream-downstream pathway. Overall, verbal humour appears to function as a preventive regulator of negative emotions by affecting subsequent early and late processing of negative stimuli, and this effect is moderated by trait anxiety.
articles.keywords: ERO; Verbal humour; emotion regulation; event-related potentials; trait anxiety
articles.summary: 本研究探讨言语幽默对高特质焦虑和低特质焦虑个体负面情绪的预防性调节作用，采用事件相关电位（ERP）和事件相关振荡（ERO）探索认知神经机制。结果显示，幽默刺激能引发更积极的情绪，并调节后续负面刺激的处理：低特质焦虑个体在幽默条件下早期注意力减少，两组均表现出晚期评估处理改变。总体而言，言语幽默通过影响后续负面刺激的早期和晚期处理来预防性调节负面情绪，且该效应受特质焦虑水平调节。

articles.title: Contemptuous expressions during encoding attenuate facial identity recognition in visual working memory in social anxiety: behavioural and electrophysiological evidence
articles.authors: Mingfan Liu, Guanlai Xiao, Xuzihui Zeng, Linran Li, Li Zhou
articles.abstract: The cognitive-behavioural model emphasises that processing biases are central to the development and maintenance of social anxiety. This study examined how contemptuous facial expressions during encoding influence subsequent recognition of neutral face identity in visual working memory. 32 socially anxious individuals and 32 healthy controls completed a delayed face discrimination task while ERPs were recorded. Behaviourally, socially anxious participants showed lower discrimination sensitivity (d', discrimination power of face identity recognition) and reduced hit rates for faces encoded with contemptuous versus happy expressions, whereas healthy controls showed comparable d' and hit rates across expression conditions. Neurally, socially anxious individuals exhibited larger P1 amplitudes during encoding, enhanced N170 amplitudes for contemptuous faces, and reduced N170 and N250 amplitudes to neutral probes previously encoded with contemptuous expressions. In contrast, healthy controls showed no significant ERP differences between expression conditions. Together, these results indicate that socially threatening cues elicit heightened early perceptual processing but impair the formation and retrieval of facial identity representations, providing converging behavioural and electrophysiological evidence of negative processing bias in social anxiety.
articles.keywords: Contemptuous expressions; Event-related potentials; Facial identity recognition; Social anxiety; Working memory
articles.summary: 本研究通过行为学和事件相关电位方法，考察了社会焦虑个体在视觉工作记忆中编码轻蔑面部表情后对中性面部身份识别的影响。结果显示，社会焦虑组的识别能力和命中率下降，并伴随P1、N170和N250等脑电成分异常，证实了社会焦虑中的负性加工偏差。

articles.title: The unique effect of the number of children on mothers' acceptance of children's negative emotions
articles.authors: Jackie A. Nelson, Carlos Carona, Helena Moreira, Ana Fonseca
articles.abstract: Although parenting research typically focuses on one target child, parents' emotion-related parenting behaviours are predicted by the broader family context. The number of children in the home impacts parents' emotional resources and may be particularly relevant to mothers' beliefs about acceptable emotional displays from their young children. Participants included 226 Portuguese mothers of a 2- to 6-year-old target child (M = 3.89 years) with between 1 and 4 children. Mothers reported on their family makeup, tolerance of their child's dominant and submissive negative emotion displays, parenting stress and mindful parenting. Covarying maternal age, family income and target child age, regressions revealed that mothers with more children were less likely to endorse beliefs that it was acceptable for their young child to display dominant negative emotions. Mothers were also more tolerant of displays of dominant negative emotions for younger children than older children within this early childhood period. These effects remained even after accounting for mothers' parenting stress and mindfulness. Results are interpreted using social information processing, emotion socialisation and transactional stress and coping perspectives.
articles.keywords: Emotion beliefs; early childhood; family size; mothers; parenting stress
articles.summary: 本研究探讨了家庭中孩子数量对母亲接受幼儿负面情绪展示的独特影响。通过对226位葡萄牙母亲的调查，在控制相关变量后，发现孩子数量越多，母亲越不接受主导性负面情绪展示；同时，母亲对年幼儿童的负面情绪展示更宽容。这些效应在控制育儿压力和正念后依然显著，研究从社会信息处理和情绪社会化等角度进行了解释。

articles.title: Attentional bias to situational and implicational information and individual differences in anxiety reactivity and perseveration
articles.authors: Moore Sophia, Dondzilo Laura, Mazidi Mahdi, Macleod Colin, Notebaert Lies
articles.abstract: There are notable individual differences in how people manage the lead up to, and aftermath of, stressful events. Trait anxiety has consistently been identified as a key factor contributing to these differences. There is growing consensus that trait anxiety is multidimensional, comprising two distinct dimensions, anxiety reactivity and anxiety perseveration. Yet the cognitive mechanisms driving individual differences in these dimensions remain unclear. The present study investigated the potential role of attentional bias towards information differing in content (situational vs. implicational) and valence (negative vs. positive) in driving these individual differences. Undergraduate university students (N = 93) completed a dual-probe assessment task which presented video clips varying in content and valence. State anxiety was assessed at crucial junctures throughout the experimental session to index anxiety reactivity and perseveration. Results revealed attentional bias for negative implicational information played a significant role in predicting anxiety perseveration. Conversely, attention bias for negative situational information was not a significant predictor of anxiety reactivity. Findings are discussed with reference to limitations and future extensions that could build on these findings to address causality and develop interventions capable of modifying cognitive biases.
articles.keywords: Anxiety; attention; cognitive processes; perseveration; reactivity
articles.summary: 本研究探讨了注意力偏差对情境与隐含信息的关注如何预测焦虑反应性和持续性的个体差异。通过双探针评估任务发现，对负面隐含信息的注意力偏差显著预测焦虑持续性，而对负面情境信息的注意力偏差则不能预测焦虑反应性。

articles.title: Emotion and list context modulate the impact of expectation on memory formation
articles.authors: Aisha Mukhtar, Alex Kafkas
articles.abstract: Emotional events are often remembered more vividly than neutral ones, and unexpected events also tend to receive enriched encoding. However, little is known about how emotional valence and expectation violations jointly shape episodic memory. This study examined their combined influence by orthogonally manipulating emotional content and expectation during encoding. Participants first learned predictive contingencies in a rule-learning task. An encoding phase followed, in which some stimuli violated established expectations, while emotional content was manipulated orthogonally to expectation. Recognition memory was then tested for expected and unexpected stimuli. In mixed-valence lists (Experiment 1), unexpected stimuli enhanced recollection for negative and neutral items but not for positive ones. When arousal was matched across valence (Experiment 2), the benefit shifted to unexpected positive and neutral stimuli. In purely emotional lists (Experiment 3), the effect of expectation violations on recollection was diminished, and memory was shaped primarily by valence, with negative stimuli eliciting greater recollection than positive ones. These findings show that the mnemonic benefit of unexpected events is not uniform but varies with valence, arousal, and list composition. They support layered models of distinctiveness, suggesting that memory emerges from the interaction of item-level expectancy, emotional salience, and contextual variability.
articles.keywords: Encoding; arousal; expectation violation; recollection; valence
articles.summary: 本研究考察了情绪效价和期望违背对情景记忆形成的共同影响。通过正交操纵情绪内容和期望，发现意外事件的记忆增强效应随情绪效价、唤醒度和列表背景的不同而变化，支持了记忆形成中独特性交互作用的分层模型。

articles.title: Distinct retrieval mechanisms for episodic and schematic categoric memories in depressed individuals: a re-analysis of autobiographical narratives
articles.authors: Noboru Matsumoto, Katsuya Tandoh, Keisuke Takano, Filip Raes, Jun Kawaguchi
articles.abstract: Increased categoric autobiographical memory is a known vulnerability factor for depression. Prior research suggests that categoric memories retrieved directly (i.e. via automatic associative processes) to negative cues and those retrieved generatively (i.e. through effortful and cue generation processes) to positive cues, are more pronounced in depression, indicating distinct mechanisms underlying negative and positive categoric memories in depression. To clarify this distinction and the broader complexity of categoric memory retrieval, the present study examined the role of cue valence and retrieval process, in conjunction with a third candidate factor: the content features of categoric memories. We conducted a mini meta-analysis across eight datasets (total N = 569) examining the relationship between depression severity and categoric memory. Each categoric memory was coded according to its content, reflecting either schematic features or episodic features. Results showed that higher depressive symptoms were associated with more schematic categoric memories retrieved directly to negative cues and more episodic (temporally nonspecific) categoric memories retrieved generatively to positive cues. Additionally, depressive symptoms were linked to more episodic categoric memories retrieved directly to negative cues. These findings support the idea that negative and positive categoric memories in depression are driven, at least in part, by different mnemonic processes.
articles.keywords: Autobiographical memory specificity; depression; overgeneral memory; schema; semantic memory
articles.summary: 本研究通过重新分析自传体叙事数据，探讨抑郁个体中情景与图式分类记忆的检索机制。发现抑郁症状与更多图式分类记忆（直接检索自负性线索）以及更多情景分类记忆（生成检索自正性线索）相关，支持抑郁中正负分类记忆由不同记忆过程驱动的观点。

articles.title: Rumination, co-rumination and latent trait cortisol (LTC): the moderating role of depression history
articles.authors: April Chi Jiun Su, Frances R. Chen, Chloe S. Kaplan, Sarah E. Kelly, Natalia Halpern Lagos, Leah D. Doane, Catherine B. Stroud
articles.abstract: Although research has linked rumination to various hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal (HPA) axis indicators, few studies have examined whether rumination - and its interpersonal counterpart, co-rumination - is uniquely associated with trait-like individual differences in HPA axis activity. The present study tested whether rumination and co-rumination were related to latent trait cortisol (LTC), a trait-like marker of individual differences in HPA axis activity, and whether these associations were moderated by current and lifetime histories of depressive symptoms. Undergraduates (N = 85; M age = 19.37 years) provided salivary cortisol samples four times daily (waking, 30 and 45 min post-waking, bedtime) over three 3-day sampling waves separated by 6 weeks. Rumination and co-rumination were assessed via self-report, and current and lifetime history of depressive symptoms via semi-structured interviews. An across-wave LTC was derived using the first two morning samples from nine collection days. Greater rumination and co-rumination were associated with lower across-wave LTC among individuals without a history of diagnosable depression. These results suggest that intrapersonal and interpersonal emotion regulation strategies are associated with individual differences in HPA axis activity primarily among those without a depressive history. This work provides novel insight into a potential physiological pathway through which rumination and co-rumination may shape the risk for the first onsets of depression.
articles.keywords: HPA axis; Latent trait cortisol; co-rumination; depression history; rumination
articles.summary: 本研究探讨了反刍和共同反刍与潜质皮质醇（LTC）的关系，以及抑郁史的调节作用。通过唾液皮质醇采样和访谈评估，发现对于没有抑郁史的个体，更高的反刍和共同反刍与更低的LTC相关，表明个体内和人际情绪调节策略与HPA轴活动的个体差异相关，且受抑郁经历调节。

articles.title: Threat prioritisation under limited awareness in social anxiety: a review of masking and suppression paradigms
articles.authors: Selen Gonul, Robert W. Booth
articles.abstract: Social anxiety (SA) is characterised by heightened vigilance to socially evaluative threat, yet the extent to which this vigilance operates outside conscious awareness remains understudied. This review synthesises evidence from 11 studies investigating threat processing in individuals with SA or elevated SA traits, using masking and suppression paradigms to manipulate visual awareness. Across paradigms, samples, and contexts, findings on threat processing under constrained awareness in SA do not converge on a consistent effect, varying instead with paradigm-specific features, awareness level, stimulus type, and task context. Conceptual and methodological heterogeneity, particularly in the definition and assessment of awareness, limits cross-study integration. SA-related effects can be better characterised as reflecting preconscious vigilance to socially evaluative cues rather than unconscious threat processing. Masking paradigms most consistently reveal early vigilance under restricted awareness, whereas interocular suppression paradigms capture later attentional dynamics (avoidance or regulatory) as stimuli compete for conscious access. These divergences highlight the need for clearer theoretical distinctions between levels of awareness, standardised awareness checks, and attention to socially evaluative context. A refined framework conceptualising SA-related threat processing along a continuum, from preconscious vigilance to conscious avoidance, may better guide future research and improve interpretability.
articles.keywords: Social anxiety; awareness; threat processing; vigilance-avoidance; visual suppression
articles.summary: 本综述整合了11项研究，探讨社交焦虑个体在视觉意识受限条件下的威胁处理，使用掩蔽和抑制范式。研究发现，现有结果不一致，受范式特征、意识水平、刺激类型和任务情境影响。作者提出，社交焦虑相关的威胁处理更可能反映前意识警觉而非无意识加工，并建议未来研究需更清晰地区分意识水平和关注社会评估情境。

articles.title: Motion and intensity shape accuracy and confusion patterns in emotion recognition
articles.authors: Simone Favelle, Özge Karakale, Lyndsay Menzies
articles.abstract: Facial expression recognition depends on both motion and intensity, but how these factors interact within and across emotions remains unclear. Here we examined recognition accuracy of basic emotions (anger, disgust, fear, joy, sadness, surprise) across low, medium, and high intensity displays of static and naturally dynamic facial expressions. Results showed while there was an overall increase in accuracy with intensity, there were complex interactions between intensity, motion, and emotion. Dynamic cues enhanced recognition of joy, surprise, and anger, particularly at low intensity, whereas disgust, fear, and sadness were recognised with greater accuracy from static expressions. We found common confusion patterns of fear-surprise, anger-sadness, and disgust-anger. However, contrary to reports of equivalent confusion patterns across dynamic and static expressions, motion reduced confusions of surprise as fear, but increased confusions of fear as surprise. This novel finding suggests that temporal unfolding facilitates recognition of surprise, but obscures cues aiding identification of fear. These patterns show that the benefits of dynamic information are intensity and emotion-specific and limited when emotions share morphological features. The current findings highlight the complexity of the role of motion and intensity in facial expression recognition and underscore the importance of employing naturally unfolding dynamic stimuli.
articles.keywords: Motion; basic emotion; emotion recognition; facial expression; intensity
articles.category: Emotion, Facial Expression, Emotion Perception, Face
articles.summary: 本研究考察了面部表情识别中运动和强度的作用及其交互影响。通过比较静态和动态面部表达在不同强度下的识别准确性，发现动态线索在低强度时能提升喜悦、惊讶和愤怒的识别，但厌恶、恐惧和悲伤在静态表达中更易识别。研究还揭示了运动对惊讶和恐惧混淆模式的相反影响，表明动态信息的好处因情绪和强度而异。

articles.title: Unpacking mentalising through its denial: Integrating the roles of perceptual and contextual cues
articles.authors: Jeroen Vaes, Daniela Ruzzante, Carolina Biasiotti
articles.abstract: Mentalising - the ability to attribute mental states to others - is essential to human social life. Starting from what we know about dehumanisation, we analyse the process of mentalising, how it is impacted by both perceptual and contextual cues, and how they unfold and integrate over time. A meta-analysis of four EEG studies tests a two-phase model that charts the dynamic progression of mentalising: An early mind detection stage (N170), where mindful human and mindless doll-like faces are differentiated for the first time; and a later mind attribution stage (P300), where perceptual and contextual information is integrated and ERP indices start correlating with an implicit, behavioural measure of mind attribution. The studies reviewed in this article provide preliminary evidence on the structure and functioning of mentalising, enabling us to formulate specific hypotheses for future research and establishing meaningful connections with related fields, such as empathy, person perception and anthropomorphism.
articles.keywords: Unpacking; Perception; Psychology; Cognitive psychology; Social psychology; Communication; Social perception; Categorical perception; Visual perception
articles.summary: 本研究探讨了心智化过程，即如何通过感知和情境线索将心理状态归因于他人的能力。基于四组EEG研究的元分析，提出了一个两阶段动态模型：早期阶段（N170）区分有心灵的人脸与无心灵的玩偶脸，后期阶段（P300）整合感知与情境信息并与隐式行为测量相关。研究为心智化的结构和功能提供了初步证据，并与同理心、人格感知等领域建立了联系。

articles.title: Humanness as Social Normativity: Neural Evidence that Humanized Faces Align with Gender Schemas
articles.authors: Fangfang Wen, Yiyan Ju, Yatian Lei, Xierzhati Abulaiti, Min Hu, Bin Zuo
articles.abstract: Perceptions of humanness are deeply intertwined with social norms, yet the specific theoretical link between humanness and gender normativity, a primary form of social normativity, remains insufficiently understood. Across four studies (N = 686), we investigated whether humanized faces are implicitly processed as more gender-normative. Study 1 (n = 400) revealed that higher humanness ratings predicted stronger femininity evaluations for female faces and stronger masculinity evaluations for male faces. Study 2 (n = 161), employing a drawing projective test, demonstrated that highly humanized mental prototypes exhibited more gender-typed traits. In Study 3 (n = 92), mouse-tracking revealed that lower Maximum Deviation (MD), an indicator of greater decisional certainty, was linked to evaluations consistent with gender schemas. Study 4 (n = 25) provided electrophysiological evidence: in masculinity-evaluation tasks, low-humanness female faces elicited enhanced N170 and LPP amplitudes, indicating increased structural encoding and motivated attention. In femininity-evaluation tasks, low-humanness faces evoked larger P300, suggesting counter-stereotypic processing. Collectively, these findings demonstrate that humanness perception reinforces gender normativity, as reflected in distinct neural signatures.
articles.keywords: Event-Related Potentials; Facial Humanness Perception; Gender Schema; Mouse-tracking; Social Norms
articles.summary: 本研究考察了人性化面孔感知与性别规范性之间的关联。通过行为实验、投射测试、鼠标追踪和脑电技术，发现人们将人性化面孔视为更符合性别图式，并在神经层面对低人性面孔表现出增强的编码和注意力，表明人性感知作为社会规范的体现。

articles.title: Scaffolding the Social Mind: Emotion Recognition Supports Mentalizing but Reinforces Bias
articles.authors: C Biasiotti, D Ruzzante, F Meconi, J Vaes
articles.abstract: Mentalizing—inferring others' mental states—is a core social function supported by both perceptual and contextual processes. Emotion recognition similarly unfolds in two stages: early perceptual decoding of facial features followed by context-sensitive interpretation. Here, we tested whether emotion recognition scaffolds mentalizing across these stages and whether they attenuate or amplify social bias. Participants (N = 34) completed a face categorization task during EEG recording, in which mentalizing was operationalized as differential neural responses to mindful (human) versus mindless (doll-like) faces, while perceptual (neutral vs. smiling) and contextual (ingroup vs. outgroup) cues were systematically manipulated. Early neural responses differentiated human from doll-like faces, indicating rapid mind detection despite perceptual similarity. Smiling expressions enhanced early neural sensitivity across both human and doll-like faces, suggesting that emotional information is extracted at early perceptual stages independently of stimulus humanity. Later EEG components revealed an asymmetry: emotional expressions selectively boosted mental state attribution for ingroup faces, reflecting the integration of contextual social information at later stages. Implicit association tests confirmed this pattern, with mind-related concepts more strongly associated with smiling ingroup faces.
articles.keywords: emotion recognition; event-related potential; mentalizing; oddball paradigm
articles.category: Emotion, Emotion Perception, Face, Social Cognition
articles.summary: 本研究通过EEG探讨了情绪识别是否支持心智化以及如何影响社会偏见。参与者完成面部分类任务，操纵感知线索（中性vs.微笑）和情境线索（内群体vs.外群体）。结果发现早期神经反应能快速区分人类与类人面孔，微笑表达增强了早期神经敏感性，但晚期成分显示情绪表达选择性增强了内群体面孔的心理状态归因，隐式关联测试证实了这种偏见模式。

articles.title: Attentional Biases in Self-Control Are Associated with Reward Cue-Related Brain Activity
articles.authors: Nitisha Desai, Allison M Londeree, Eunbin Kim, Kentaro Fujita, Dylan Wagner, Ian Krajbich
articles.abstract: Successfully resolving self-control conflicts requires individuals to integrate information about the hedonic value of a temptation with its impact on distant goals. Functional neuroimaging research demonstrates that cue-related activity in the brain's reward system predicts self-control failures ranging from weight gain and drug use to gambling disorders. Despite this work, it remains unclear what components of the decision-making process are associated with neural cue-reactivity. The present study integrates eye-tracking and computational modeling of food choices using the attentional Drift Diffusion Model with neural measures of food cue-reactivity in a sample of chronic dieters. Our results show that activity to tempting food cues in the nucleus accumbens and orbitofrontal cortex is associated with an attentional bias towards unhealthy food items during a food choice task. Moreover, functional and structural connectivity between the brain's reward system and a prefrontal region implicated in response inhibition, were associated with a reduction in the drift rate for unhealthy food items and with the ability to maintain healthy items in mind even when gaze is directed towards unhealthy food items. Together, these findings help elucidate the relationship between neural cue-reactivity and dietary decision-making and suggest attentional biases as one mechanism through which cue-reactivity is associated with self-control failure.
articles.keywords: Cue-Reactivity; Decision Making; Reward; Self-Control; Self-Regulation
articles.summary: 本研究整合眼动追踪和计算建模，考察慢性节食者食物选择中神经线索反应与注意力偏差的关联。结果显示，伏隔核和眶额皮层对诱惑食物线索的活动与对不健康食物的注意力偏差相关，且奖励系统与前额抑制区域的连接能降低不健康食物的漂移率并维持对健康食物的注意力。这些发现阐明了神经线索反应在饮食决策中的作用，并提示注意力偏差是其与自我控制失败关联的机制之一。

articles.title: Making new connections: An fNIRS machine learning classification study of inter-brain synchrony in the default mode network
articles.authors: Grace Qiyuan Miao, Ian J Lieberman, Ashley Binnquist, Agnieszka Pluta, Bear M Goldstein, Rick Dale, Matthew D Lieberman
articles.abstract: Little is known about the neurocognitive underpinnings of forming social connections. In this study, we tested whether default mode network (DMN) inter-brain synchrony (which prior work has linked to interpersonal alignment, or 'seeing eye-to-eye') predicts feelings of connection during conversations. Seventy pairs of strangers engaged in shallow or deep conversations while brain activity was measured with functional near infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS). Stranger dyads in the deep condition felt more connected than those in the shallow condition. Greater feelings of connection were associated with increased DMN synchrony, with the right temporoparietal junction (TPJ) subregion of the DMN emerging as the strongest individual predictor across regression analyses and machine learning classification. These findings suggest that DMN synchrony in general and TPJ synchrony in particular may play a key role in strangers coming to 'see eye-to-eye' during face-to-face interactions and feeling more socially connected.
articles.keywords: communication; default mode network; functional near infrared spectroscopy; inter-brain synchrony; social connection
articles.summary: 本研究通过fNIRS机器学习分类，探讨了陌生人对话中默认模式网络的间脑同步与社交连接感的关系。结果发现，深层对话比浅层对话引发更强的连接感，且连接感与默认模式网络同步增加显著相关，其中右侧颞顶联合区是最强的预测因子。

articles.title: Hierarchical systems in the default mode network when reasoning about self and other mental states
articles.authors: Isaac R Christian, Samuel A Nastase
articles.abstract: Humans spend considerable time contemplating the minds of others. But this ability is not limited to external agents-we also turn the lens for reading minds inward, reflecting on our own thoughts, emotions, and sense of self. Some processes involved in reasoning about minds may rely on shared mechanisms, while others may be specific to the agent under consideration. We developed a paradigm where participants performed either a mental state inference task or a control task targeting either another person presented onscreen or their own mind. Using fMRI and multi-voxel pattern analysis, we replicate a well-established self-other gradient along the medial prefrontal wall: ventral regions encoded mental state inference patterns for self, but not other, whereas more dorsal regions encoded mental state inference for both self and other, compared to control conditions. Posterior cingulate cortex, on the other hand, differentiated the target of mental state inference. Using a cross-classification analysis, we also found patterns in the dorsomedial prefrontal cortex, ventromedial prefrontal cortex, and right temporoparietal junction were sensitive to mental state reasoning, regardless of the target agent. Our findings reveal a functional hierarchy for mental state reasoning where certain areas support agent-specific reasoning and others support more abstract, agent-general reasoning.
articles.keywords: fMRI; mentalizing; multi-voxel pattern analysis; social cognition; social reasoning; theory of mind
articles.summary: 本研究利用功能磁共振成像和多体素模式分析，探究了自我与他人心理状态推理的神经机制。结果发现内侧前额叶皮层存在自我-他人梯度，腹侧区域特异于自我心理状态推理，背侧区域对自我和他人推理均有表征；后扣带皮层则区分推理目标。这表明心理状态推理具有功能层级，部分脑区支持特定主体推理，部分支持更抽象的通用推理。

articles.title: Multimodal correlates of socioemotional movie-watching and their associations with internalizing symptoms in childhood and adulthood
articles.authors: Sofia Scatolin, Elena Federici, Plamina Dimanova, Réka Borbás, Mirjam Habegger, Nora Maria Raschle
articles.abstract: Socioemotional skills emerge from coordinated behavioral, autonomic, and neural processes that continue to reorganize across development, yet how these systems jointly support emotion processing and mental health remains unclear. Using a naturalistic movie-watching paradigm, we integrated behavioral, cardiac, and fMRI measures in children (6-14 years) and adults (18-29 years), alongside independent ratings of experienced valence and arousal. Across age groups, positive and negative emotional content elicited changes in subjective experience, heart rate, and corticolimbic activity, including the amygdala, hippocampus, and prefrontal cortex. Despite these shared patterns, group differences emerged. Children reported more positive affect, showed larger heart-rate deceleration, and exhibited stronger recruitment of thalamic and lateral prefrontal regions, areas previously linked to sensory integration and cognitive control. Adults, in contrast, showed greater activation in hippocampal and posterior midline regions, which have previously been associated with memory and self-referential appraisal. During negative emotional content specifically, children preferentially engaged medial prefrontal regions, whereas adults engaged lateral prefrontal regions. Importantly, in adults but not children, models combining behavioral, cardiac, and neural indices explained substantially more variance in internalizing symptoms than any single modality alone. Together, these findings demonstrate that socioemotional experiences evoke coordinated behavioral, autonomic, and neural responses across development, while also revealing age-group differences in their organization and associations with mental well-being.
articles.keywords: affect; development; emotion; fMRI; heart rate; movie-watching
articles.summary: 本研究使用自然电影观看范式，整合行为、心率和fMRI数据，考察儿童和成人的社会情绪处理及其与内部化症状的关联。结果显示，正性和负性情绪内容均能引发主观体验、心率和皮质边缘脑区的活动变化，但儿童表现出更强的丘脑和外侧前额叶激活，成人则更多激活海马和后中线区域。此外，在成人中，多模态指标比单一模态更能解释内部化症状的变异。

articles.title: Emotional Information Recruits Specific Neural Dynamics to Support Hierarchical Cognitive Control
articles.authors: Wenquan Zhang, Xinyao Li, Zimeng Li, Pinrong Chen, Bo Zhang, Xiaoya Liu, Shuang Liu, Dong Ming
articles.abstract: Hierarchical cognitive control supports flexible behavior guided by abstract goals; however, how emotional information modulates the underlying neural dynamics across hierarchy levels remains unclear. To fill this gap, we designed emotional and non-emotional hierarchical cognitive control paradigms, with hierarchical demands manipulated by varying abstraction levels of task rules. Forty-one participants performed the experiment, with electroencephalography (EEG) and eye-tracking data simultaneously recorded. By aligning EEG with eye-tracking data through time-locked analyses, we characterized oscillatory dynamics of each hierarchy level, integrating single-frequency (power spectral density, PSD) and cross-frequency (phase-amplitude coupling, PAC) features. Results showed that increasing hierarchical demands enhanced PSD across multiple frequency bands in both emotional and non-emotional contexts. Both contexts also exhibited enhanced narrowband delta-beta PAC with increasing abstraction. Importantly, emotional hierarchical demands additionally elicited PAC patterns beyond those in non-emotional contexts, such as delta-alpha and alpha-beta couplings. Topographical clustering revealed that emotion-related PAC activity predominated in fronto-parietal and temporo-occipital regions. These findings suggest that while the brain utilizes general neural dynamics for processing abstract goals, emotional demands recruit additional neural resources to support it. Beyond elucidating how the brain integrates affect with abstract cognitive events, this study offers potential neurodynamic signatures and intervention targets for affective and cognitive disorders.
articles.keywords: EEG; Emotion; Eye-tracking; Hierarchical cognitive control; Neural oscillations; Phase-amplitude coupling
articles.summary: 本研究探讨情绪信息如何调节层级认知控制的神经动态。通过结合EEG和眼动追踪数据，发现情绪层级需求额外引发了特定的跨频耦合模式，如delta-alpha和alpha-beta耦合，表明情绪招募了额外的神经资源来支持抽象目标处理，相关活动主要分布在额顶和颞枕区域。

articles.title: Home alone: Remote work, isolation, and mental health
articles.authors: Natalia Emanuel, Emma Harrington, Amanda Pallais
articles.abstract: How does remote work affect isolation and mental health? We drew on five nationally representative surveys of American workers ( N = 588,322) conducted from 2011 to 2024, omitting the peak pandemic years of 2020-2021. Our difference-in-differences approach compared changes in mental health among people in remotable jobs—who experienced a large and persistent rise in remote work since COVID-19—to people in nonremotable jobs, where remote work increased far less. We found that remote work increases time spent alone, worsens mental well-being across multiple measures, and increases the use of mental health services and prescriptions. These effects were concentrated among individuals living alone. We estimate that the rise of remote work explains about a third of the increase in isolation and mental distress between 2011-2019 and 2022-2024.
articles.keywords: Mental health; Affect; Isolation; Work; Mental distress; Distress; Psychological distress; Psychology
articles.summary: 本研究基于美国工人的全国代表性调查数据，采用双重差分法考察远程工作对隔离感和心理健康的影响。发现远程工作显著增加独处时间、恶化多个心理健康指标，并提升心理健康服务和处方的使用，效应在独居个体中尤为明显。估计远程工作的兴起解释了2011年至2024年间隔离和心理困扰增长的大约三分之一。

articles.title: Perceived versus Objective Cultural Distance: Differential Effects on Acculturation Experiences
articles.authors: Yangyilin Guo, Frankie Y. Zhong, Steven J. Heine
articles.abstract: How do perceived and objective cultural distance compare in predicting immigrants' acculturation experiences? Using data from a diverse sample of immigrants residing in the United States ( N = 939), we examined perceived cultural distance alongside objective cultural distance measured by the Cultural Fixation Index ( CF ST ), a novel and flexible metric derived from World Values Survey data that captures between-group variation in cultural values. Our findings reveal that perceived cultural distance, assessed using the Brief Perceived Cultural Distance Scale, was more often associated with psychological outcomes, including higher homesickness (β = .08) and lower psychological adaptation (β = −.08). In contrast, objective cultural distance was negatively associated with physical health (β = −.16), and stronger orientations toward host culture (β = .08). The two measures were moderately correlated ( r = .34), and both predicted greater culture shock and stronger heritage culture orientation. Neither objective nor perceived cultural distance significantly predicted depressive symptoms or anxiety. These findings highlight the importance of assessing both subjective perceptions and objective measures of cultural differences when studying acculturation and considering their respective trade-offs.
articles.keywords: Acculturation; Psychology; Social psychology; Cultural diversity; Perception; Cultural group selection; Hofstede's cultural dimensions theory; Immigration; Cultural identity; Cultural heritage
articles.summary: 本研究比较了感知和客观文化距离对移民文化适应经验的不同影响。基于美国移民样本数据，应用新的文化固定指数测量客观距离，发现感知距离更常预测心理结果如思乡和心理适应，而客观距离与身体健康和文化取向相关。结果强调在研究文化适应时需同时考虑主观感知和客观测量。

articles.title: Balancing Self- and Other-Orientations in Parental Emotion Socialization Goals and Implications for Child Development in China
articles.authors: Ruyi Ding, Yunbei Xie, Qian Wang
articles.abstract: Emotion socialization goals (ESGs) refer to parental expectations and aspirations for their children's emotional development. This research aims to explore what ESGs are held by contemporary Chinese parents, and how different ESGs relate to parental emotion-related socialization behaviors (ERSBs) and child outcomes in China. Three empirical studies were conducted. In Study 1, parents' ( n = 150, 78% females, 36-57 years old) written responses to an open-ended question about their emotion socialization goals were analyzed using a hybrid inductive-deductive coding approach, with the aim of identifying emergent themes and confirming the theorized dimensions of ESGs. In Study 2, a survey-based study involving parents ( n = 1,417; 57.66% females, M age = 41.94 years old, SD = 4.52) was conducted to examine the basic psychometric properties of the newly developed scale using factor analyses and test its criterion-related validity. Factor analyses revealed three factors: extreme self-oriented, balanced, and extreme other-oriented ESGs. The results showed that parents with balanced ESGs tended to exhibit more supportive ERSBs and experienced less emotional dysfunction, while parents with extreme ESGs tended to display more nonsupportive ERSBs and have more emotional dysfunction. Even after controlling parental socialization goals or parents' own emotional dysfunction, the three kinds of ESGs explained additional variances in predicting parental ERSBs. Based on parent-child dyads ( n = 483; for children: M age = 14.01 years old, SD = 0.93, 41.03% females; for parents: M age = 42.05 years old, SD = 4.60, 49.90% females), Study 3 explored how ESGs relate to children's psychosocial problems. The results showed that balanced ESGs were linked negatively with children's psychosocial problems. Extreme self-oriented ESGs but not extreme other-oriented ones had significant positive associations with children's psychosocial problems. Moreover, ERSBs significantly accounted for the relations between ESGs and children's psychosocial problems. The findings suggest that ESGs of Chinese parents are multi-dimensional and have close relevance to parental ERSBs and child outcomes.
articles.keywords: Psychology; Socialization; Developmental psychology; Scale; Psychosocial; Social psychology; Empirical research; Erikson's stages of psychosocial development; Test
articles.summary: 本研究探讨了中国父母的情绪社会化目标，通过三个实证研究识别出三个维度：极端自我导向、平衡和极端他人导向。平衡的ESGs与更支持性的父母情绪相关社会化行为及孩子更少的社会心理问题相关，而极端的ESGs则与负面结果关联。

articles.title: Corrigendum to "Classifying and Understanding Worldviews in Mental Health: A Scoping Review"
